sentences.text:
The Honourable Smt. Justice K. Sujana
 Criminal Petition No.7356 Of 2024
Order:

This Criminal Petition has been filed, under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short, 'Cr.P.C.'), by the petitioner/accused seeking to quash the proceedings against him in Crime No.95 of 2024 on the file of the Station House Officer, Masab Tank Police Station, for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 313, 417, 420, 509 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. The brief history of the case is that the victim is the resident of Bhadradri-Kothagudem and she got acquaintance with the petitioner, who has been residing in the pent house situated in the building where the victim is also residing, and that after two months of their acquaintance, the petitioner has proposed his love to the victim.
After that they had sexual intercourse resulting which the victim got pregnancy for which the petitioner got her aborted as such the victim asked the petitioner to marry her.
While so, on 28.01.2024 in the presence of elders and relatives, their engagement was performed.
Later, when the victim started asking him about their marriage, the petitioner used to abuse her in filthy language stating that he is not interested to perform marriage with her.
He used to insult and threaten her over mobile phone as and when she asked about their marriage.
As there was no other go, she lodged a report before the police.

3. The case of the petitioner is that the ingredients in the complaint did not constitute any evidence to show that the petitioner and the victim were in love and also with the consent of his family,
engagement was taken place in the month of January, 2024 and that there was some internal issues cropped up between both the families, therefore, marriage was delayed.
Owing to these differences the victim has filed complaint before police which led to further complications.

Pending adjudication of the said complaint, the marriage of the petitioner was performed with the victim on 24.04.2024 at Temple and their marriage was also registered vide Document bearing No.H.M.No.515/HM/2024, dated 02.07.2024.
Now, they are living happily under one roof as husband and wife and there are no disputes between them.
The petitioner has placed reliance on Sheikh Arif v. The State of Maharashtra 1.

entities.text: Sheikh Arif v. The State of Maharashtra
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Crl.A.No.1368 of 2023 dated 30.01.2024.

4. Heard Mr.T.Bala Mohan Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri D.Arun Kumar, Additional Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1 and Mr.Mohammed Nazeerudhin Khan, learned counsel for respondent No.2 and perused the record.
5.

Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner as well as learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 have submitted that the grievance of the victim is that the petitioner refused to marry her,
whereas, subsequently, they both got married and their marriage was registered and a certificate T. Venu vs The State Of Telangana on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74857343/
1 was issued, which was placed on record, as such requested this Court to quash the proceedings pending against the petitioner.

entities.text: T. Venu vs The State Of Telangana on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Having regard to the submissions made by the learned counsel appearing for either of the parties and taken on record the fact that the complaint was lodged by the victim stating that they both loved each other and after they got engaged, the petitioner refused to marry her as such she requested the police to take action.
The main allegation against the petitioner is that he refused to marry the victim, now, the marriage was performed and to that effect marriage certificate was also issued.

Therefore, this Court is of the considered opinion that nothing remains to proceed with against the petitioner and continuation of proceedings is nothing but abuse of process of law.
7.

In view of the aforesaid reasons, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings in Crime No.95 of 2024 on the file of the Station House Officer, Masab Tank Police Station, pending against the petitioner, are hereby quashed.
Pending Miscellaneous Applications, if any, shall stand closed.
